title: stacked-word-tower — one word per line, each sized to the same width
idea: The headline breaks one word per line, each word sized so every line reaches the same width — a solid block of type where the size differences come from the words themselves.
why_new: Every recipe sets one headline at one size. Per-line sizing is a different typographic object and the fit-text device already exists to do it.
built_from: three headings (or one heading of three fit-text lines) inside a constrained group; imageless, solid surface.
risk: only works for a three-to-five word headline with words of similar length; needs a word-shape gate, and the copy step must be told to write for it.
